kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نذلعب (form IVq)
# نَذْلَعِبُّ (naḏlaʕibbu) /nað.la.ʕib.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِذْلَعَبَّ (iḏlaʕabba)
# نَذْلَعِبَّ (naḏlaʕibba) /nað.la.ʕib.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِذْلَعَبَّ (iḏlaʕabba)
# نَذْلَعِبِّ (naḏlaʕibbi) /nað.la.ʕib.bi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِذْلَعَبَّ (iḏlaʕabba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
